all_formal_runtime_states.translation_collision: camera radius 0.15 m plus safety margin 0.05 m; colliding translation is invalidated
all_formal_runtime_states.success_evaluation: canonical_spatial_task_h1_v1 is evaluated after each legal action

certificate_generator_state_subset.relationship_to_runtime: A stricter data-quality subset of formal runtime states; these gates do not redefine runtime transition legality.
requirements: same room as the source pair/initial

initial_only.official_rgb: initial frame must pass projective_observability_v1_initial_keyframe dual-target observation

terminal_success.success_region: any canonical-success runtime state; no equality to sample_target or generator seed pose

medium_difficulty_certification.lower_bound: complete forward-runtime enumeration has no canonical success through depth 3
medium_difficulty_certification.upper_bound: independently replayed certificate reaches first canonical success at step 4, 5, or 6

inside_frame_audit.projective_meaning: clipped projected bbox area divided by raw projected bbox area, at least 0.50 for each object
inside_frame_audit.fov_rule_is_distinct: FOV uses 0.95 full-bbox fraction plus 5% center margin
inside_frame_audit.observability_0.25_is_distinct: The official RGB heuristic has a calibrated 0.25 patch-inside minimum; generator initial geometry remains the stricter frozen canonical 0.50 prefilter.
